modification_description: Three modifications requested: (1) prioritize time-to-relief so the fastest method to stop flea biting is chosen, allowing lethal removal even when non-lethal relocation cannot achieve rapid relief; (2) expand 'least harmful method available' to include veterinary best-practice options such as flea combing combined with environmental treatment and vet-safe preventatives, which may not involve direct killing but effectively end infestation and dog suffering; (3) scope any lethal removal to the minimal amount necessary to prevent ongoing harm (itching, dermatitis, secondary infection), rather than treating lethality as a general default once the threshold is crossed.
